operations.name: Cancel a run
operations.description: Cancel a queued or running Agent run immediately without returning any results. You are billed for usage accrued before cancellation. If the run has already reached a terminal status, the API returns the existing run.

operations.name: Cancel a batch
operations.description: Request cancellation of a batch. The batch stops scheduling new requests and drains in-flight work before settling to `cancelled`. Cancelling a batch that is already `cancelling` or `cancelled` is idempotent and returns the batch unchanged. A batch that has already reached a terminal status (`completed` or `expired`) cannot be cancelled and the request fails with a 409.

Exa-Beta.description: Required beta token for the Batch API.
